NONE: › on, affecting, or referring to the same side of the body
› used to say that it is reasonable to state or believe something based on facts that are already known

example: You admit you fired the gun and we now know that the shot killed the victim so you are, ipso facto, responsible for his death.
你承認開過槍，而現在我們知道這一槍殺死了受害人，因此根據事實你應對他的死負責。
